{{Quote|My pets are ready to play. Are you?|Rora Seake|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
'''Rora Seake''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Known as a [[Beastmaster/Legends|master of beasts]], Seake kept two massive creatures known as [[jurgoran]]s as her pets and [[Animal bond|controlled]] them in combat. In [[3643 BBY]], she was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to wipe out a [[Lake Brell colony|small Republic colony]], but the secrecy of her mission was compromised, and a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] defended the colony against Seake, [[Death/Legends|killing]] both her and her pets.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is horrible. We're not prepared for this.''"<br />"''Then you should not have come back to a world that is not yours.|The colonist [[Yelzrin]] and Rora Seake|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Rora Seake was [[Sith training|trained]] as a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and acquired two [[jurgoran]]s&mdash;large creatures from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]&mdash;that she kept as pets, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Animal bond|control]] them. As a result, she gained a reputation among the Empire as a [[Beastmaster/Legends|master of beasts]].<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Seake was sent to the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and tasked with wiping out one of the Republic's new [[Lake Brell colony|colony settlements]] that it was establishing as part of its [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement efforts]]. Seake was also alerted to the presence of [[Watcher One]], an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the Empire's [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence branch]] who was working for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]. Seake brought her two pet jurgorans along with her to Taris and soon located her target&mdash;a bunker built along the shores of [[Lake Brell]].<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

[[File:Lake_Brell_colony_bunker.png|thumb|left|200px|The colony that Seake attacked]]
{{GameLS}}
However, Seake was irritated to find that a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was already in the colony and was attempting to evacuate the colonists before she arrived. The Knight had learned of Seake's mission from the Imperial [[operative]] Watcher One and had rushed to intercept the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. As the presence of Seake and her jurgorans sent the colonists into a panic, the assassin warned the colonists that they should not have returned to Taris, and she questioned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as to how her opponent had learned of her supposedly secret mission. Seake then retreated and entered into a [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] state in order to control her jurgorans, but when the two creatures were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a companion, an enraged Seake drew her own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and attacked the Jedi herself&mdash;a [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|duel]] that ended with her death.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Taris belongs to the Sith Empire&mdash;now and forever. Even my beasts understand that.|Rora Seake|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
Rora Seake possessed a haughty attitude and believed in the superiority of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. She cared nothing for the feelings or well being of her pets and believed that because a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] had once ruled Taris, the planet was therefore forever a Sith world. Seake had the crimson skin and facial tendrils common to her species and had [[Color/Legends|reddish-orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|They're only afraid of me. You&hellip; just make them hungry.|Seake, referring to her jurgoran pets|<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />}}
[[File:Seake_and_pets.png|thumb|right|230px|Rora Seake controlled her pets through fear and the Force.]]
A skilled assassin, Seake was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was proficient with various forms of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. She could take mental control of her jurgoran pets by entering a meditative trance; such a trance caused her to float above the ground, and she generated a sphere of lightning around herself while doing so. Seake was also trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and for covert assassination missions.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

==Equipment==
Seake wielded an orange-colored [[lightsaber]] and wore light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a face guard.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rora Seake appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "A More Immediate Concern" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The mission is only received if the player has a positive [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment at the end of the previous mission, while [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] players are instead sent to acquire stolen [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi relics]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Players can also refuse the mission to help the colonists, which rewards the player with dark side alignment points. As the Jedi Knight is a Republic class and is thus assumed to make decisions that reward in the maximum light side points, this article assumes the player saved the colonists and killed Seake.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> According to the game's text files, players originally were able to [[Mind trick/Legends|Force Persuade]] Seake into leaving, but that option was removed from the final game.<ref name="Text">Dialogue files from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'': "[Force Persuade] Walk away."</ref>
